name: PSVDAG–SVDAG Conversion Algorithm
aliases: Pointerless Sparse Voxel Directed Acyclic Graph to Sparse Voxel Directed Acyclic Graph conversion
definition: A conversion algorithm that transforms a Pointerless Sparse Voxel Directed Acyclic Graph (PSVDAG) into a Sparse Voxel Directed Acyclic Graph (SVDAG). The PSVDAG uses variable-length Labels/Callers for common subtree merging (CSM) and intermittent binary encoding, while the SVDAG uses constant-length 32-bit pointers and uninterrupted binary sequences for internal nodes.
summary: The PSVDAG–SVDAG Conversion Algorithm transforms a pointerless graph into a pointer-based structure, enabling efficient rendering and child subtree merging at the cost of increased memory usage.
